# Handled

> Done-for-you computer work for small businesses, based in St. George, Utah (HQZ LLC). We build websites from a business's Google listing, fix and optimize Google Business Profiles, do back-office computer work for contractors, run win-back text campaigns, and offer patient tech help for seniors. Fixed prices, quoted before work starts. Call or text (435) 429-0984, support@handleditforyou.com.

## Services
- [Computer tasks](https://handleditforyou.com/computer-tasks/): one-off computer jobs done for you (online listings on the customer's own accounts, data entry, PDFs, flyers, spreadsheets, logo cleanup, website updates); fixed quote within one business day, before we start.
- [Reseller listing service](https://handleditforyou.com/reseller-listing-service/): we list a customer's clothes and other items on their own Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, eBay or Facebook Marketplace account from their phone photos; real photos first, AI styled shots only as extras; we never hold their money or items and never ship; fixed quote within one business day, before we start.
- [eBay listing service](https://handleditforyou.com/ebay-listing-service/): we list a customer's items on their own eBay account from their phone photos (photos cleaned up, titles, item specifics, honest descriptions, price from real sold listings); remote, no drop-off or consignment; we never hold their money or items and never ship; fixed quote within one business day, before we start.
- [Web design in St. George](https://handleditforyou.com/web-design-st-george/): websites for local businesses, built first; pay only if you like it.
- [Local SEO in St. George](https://handleditforyou.com/seo-st-george/): Google Business Profile, reviews and directory cleanup.
- [Google Business Profile suspended](https://handleditforyou.com/google-business-profile-suspended/): fix and appeal.
- [Virtual assistant for contractors](https://handleditforyou.com/virtual-assistant-for-contractors/): estimates, invoices, follow-ups and listings.
- [Win back past customers](https://handleditforyou.com/win-back-past-customers/): seasonal text campaigns to a business's past customers.
- [Handled Growth System](https://handleditforyou.com/growth-system/): for trades with more than one leak: website + Google listing + directories, past-customer win-back, review texts (same link for every customer), missed-call text-back and monthly care, as one plan; $288 to set up, then $147/mo for 6 months and $97/mo after; cancel any month after the first 3; no ads, no promised bookings.
- [Social media posts](https://handleditforyou.com/social-media-posts/): a week of posts made from a business's real reviews and photos, designed, captioned and scheduled; $49 starter week, $149/mo or $249/mo.
- [Apple Business Connect setup](https://handleditforyou.com/apple-business-connect-setup/): Apple Maps place card claimed, verified and filled out ($99); stuck or pending verification fixed ($49, no fix no fee).
- [Salons & beauty](https://handleditforyou.com/salons-and-beauty/): social posts from real reviews, booking-ready websites and Google listings for salons, barbers, nail and lash techs.
- [Short-term rental hosts](https://handleditforyou.com/short-term-rental-hosts/): direct-booking info sites, guidebooks, listing copy and review-reply help for vacation rental hosts.
- [Business email setup](https://handleditforyou.com/business-email-setup/): Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 on your domain, set up so mail stops landing in spam ($149; spam fix $99).
- [Business texting registration help](https://handleditforyou.com/10dlc-registration-help/): A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and rejected-campaign fixes ($149; fix $99, no fix no fee).
- [Get on every map](https://handleditforyou.com/get-on-every-map/): Apple Maps, Bing Places and Nextdoor claimed and verified, plus other directories matched to Google ($149).
- [Tech help for seniors](https://handleditforyou.com/tech-help/): patient help with phones, computers, email and scams.
- [Free ride-along](https://handleditforyou.com/ride-along/): a free 30-minute screen-share that ends in a written, fixed-price hand-off list.

## Questions people ask
- **How can you do it so fast?** Because this is all we do. We've built our own tools and processes for exactly this kind of work, so jobs that take most people weeks take us days.
- **How much is a website?** $288 one-time for the build (our founding-client price for the first 10 clients; regular $500), plus $29 a month for hosting and small edits. We build it first and you see it finished before you pay anything. No long contract, and if you leave we hand you your content.
- **Do I have to be local?** No. We work with businesses and people nationwide. Everything happens online, by email, Instagram message, or a quick video call if you want one.
- **What if I'm not happy with it?** We revise until it's right. It isn't done until you say it's handled.
- **How will I know it's working?** Every month you get a short, plain-English report: calls, form fills, reviews and where you show up on Google. Not a page of jargon and charts.
- **What can't you do?** We don't give legal, tax or financial advice, and we won't do anything that requires a licence we don't hold. If it's outside our lane, we'll tell you up front.
- **What's a ride-along?** A free 30-minute video call where you share your screen and do your normal office work while we watch. Afterwards you get a written list of what we'd take off your plate, each with a fixed price. You never give us a password, and the list is yours to keep either way. Book one here.
- **Do you have a referral deal?** Yes. When a business you refer signs up for a monthly plan, your next month is free. They just need to mention your name.
- **Is my information kept private?** Yes. Your files are used only for your job and never shared or shown to anyone without your written OK.
